remarks: Spacious and impeccably maintained unit in a highly desirable East Norwalk neighborhood-enjoy coastal living at its best! Just a short walk to the beach, train station, Ludlow Park, and the expansive dog park at Taylor Farm. A short walk to waterfront restaurants, kayaking options, Marina's and all waterfront activities you can imagine. This like-new 2-bedroom, 2-bath home features gleaming hardwood floors, granite countertops, high ceilings with crown molding, energy-efficient gas heating , and very energy efficient overall. Both bedrooms have en-suite full bathrooms, and the primary suite includes a large walk-in closet. Additional highlights include central air, in-unit washer/dryer, basement storage, and off-street parking on a quiet dead-end street. Plus, enjoy the convenience of a temperature controlled detached 2 car garage-a rare find in this area. No expense spared, owners former residence, see for yourself.
